P19-21.name: ［Diva Academy］Rei-Ohba
P19-21.effect:
Flash - [Grand Advent: Diva & Cost 5 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By either sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, or putting a core from your Grandwalker Nexus to any Spirit, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[team: Shiny Hearts]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
Return two opposing Spirits to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
"Diva" family Brave Spirits you control can't be blocked.

PB15-D01.name: ［Halloween Party］Rei-Ohba
PB15-D01.effect:
[team: Shiny Hearts]

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (Your Draw Step)
By discarding a "Rei-Ohba" from your Hand, increase the number of cards you draw by +1.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send two cores from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve, and when depletes, you can summon a Brave card with one symbol or less from your Hand, without paying the cost.

PB15-D02.name: ［Halloween Witch］Jeanne Doraniece
PB15-D02.effect:
[team: Twilight Gothic]

[Mirage: Cost 4 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
By discarding this Mirage, refresh a "Rei-Ohba" you control.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
When you are summoning "Rei-Ohba", this Spirit gains an extra Yellow symbol.

PB18-X01.name: ［School Festival Princess］Rei-Ohba
PB18-X01.effect:
[team: Shiny Hearts]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add every "Rei-Ohba" and Brave card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. Also, if this Spirit is braved to a Brave, besides any "［School Festival Princess］Rei-Ohba", refresh every "Rei-Ohba" you control.
